## Objective
The repository is empty. Add a single Java source file with a runnable Hello World program.

## Interface
File `src/HelloWorld.java` declares `public class HelloWorld` with `public static void main(String[] args)`. It sits in the default package, so it has no `package` line.

## Behavior
1. Running `HelloWorld` prints exactly `Hello from the reviewed plan!` followed by a newline to standard output.
2. It prints nothing else.

## Invariants
Plain JDK only. No build tool and no dependencies.

## Edge cases
None.

## Guardrails
Create only `src/HelloWorld.java`. Do not add build files or tests. Do not commit compiled `.class` files.

## Out of scope
Build tooling, tests, README.
